name: GAN 16 3x3 Max Aqualis (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets) - Limited Edition
description: GAN's flagship 3x3 just got a summer edition! The GAN 16 3x3 Max Aqualis (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets) - Limited Edition is a flagship magnetic speed cube that wraps the same top-of-class Max hardware (MagLev core, corner-to-core magnets, and 72 tuning combinations) in an iridescent pink-violet pearl shell exclusive to this limited release.
features: Flagship feel, limited look: the same elite Max performance serious solvers rely on, in an Aqualis colorway you won't find in the standard lineup.
Fast now, tunable for life: factory-magnetized and quick out of the box, with 72 setting combinations so the cube grows with you instead of being replaced.
A collectible you actually solve with: themed Aqualis packaging and an exclusive sticker set, on hardware built to compete.
72 setting combinations: GAN's adjustment system tunes magnet strength and tension together, taking the cube from loose-and-fast to tight-and-controlled.
Adjustable magnets: set how firmly each layer clicks into place to match your turning style.
MagLev tensioning: repelling magnets replace the springs for a smoother, more consistent feel as you dial in your setup.
